pages.text:
One day my sister and I
were walking near the
road.

A big truck was driving
down the hill.

A car was speeding up
the hill.

The truck driver was
talking on his cell
phone.
He was not looking at
the road.

The truck smashed into
the car!

An ambulance and the
police came to help.

Two tow trucks came.
One towed the truck.
The other towed the
car.

We saw everything.
We were shocked.
